name: askdock-mobile-tall-crush
description: ask dock on a phone: inline bold option labels (no chip pills) never overlap their detail text and wrap inside the card however long they are, and a tall batch must stay inside the pane (capped + internally scrollable) instead of squeezing the transcript to zero and clipping under the pane's overflow:hidden

mutation.note: Re-verified after the ask-dialog UX rework replaced chip pills with inline-flow bold labels: removing the dock containment pair lets a tall batch escape the pane. The label assertions (no overlap, no horizontal escape) are structural to the inline-flow .option layout and have no single removable declaration that breaks them.
